integrity: A standalone, independently structured finite exhaustive checker was executed; the theorem is proved by local equivalences and equality cases rather than by finite extrapolation.
limitations: The cardinality polynomial is expressed as a sum over core subsets; no polynomial-time algorithm for unrestricted core graphs is claimed.
The result counts labeled vertex subsets, not optimizer isomorphism orbits.
No independent external mathematical audit has been performed.
Possible unindexed equivalent work on capacity domination or private-clique coronas remains a literature risk.
title: Clique-corona limited domination: a complete cardinality polynomial and an optimizer transition
